newsitem.title: USA: U.S. West spot power eases as more supply emerges.
newsitem.headline: U.S. West spot power eases as more supply emerges.

text.p: Spot power prices in the western U.S. eased amid lower demand and the restart of a Montana coal-fired unit, trade sources said Thursday.
"There has been quite a range, but prices have settled down. I think a few marketers waited a little too long to sell," said one utility trader.
Next-day spot prices nearly doubled between Monday and Wednesday amid frigid weather and unplanned power plant outages.
But the restart early Thursday of the 700 megawatt (MW) coal-fired unit at the Colstrip plant in Montana was expected to help ease the tightness.
Still, a 350 MW unit at the Comanche coal-fired plant in Colorado was shut Wednesday and is expected to be down for two or three weeks.

Also, a 720 MW unit at the Navajo plant in Arizona remains off-line after a planned maintenance outage was extended to early next week and a 550 MW unit at the Jim Bridger plant in Wyoming is expected to be shut late Friday for short-term work.
"Whenever there is a spurt of cold weather, people get nervous, especially if they are short," said another trader.
But temperatures in the Northwest are expected to range some 5 to 10 degrees below normal for the next few days, compared with 10 to 15 degrees below average recently.
Firm, peak electricity at COB on Friday was quoted $35.00-38.00 per megawatt hour (MWh), compared with $40.00-50.00 for Thursday.
Firm, off-peak COB power for Friday was little changed near $21.00.
Friday firm, peak power at Mid-Columbia (Mid-C) was pegged at $35.00-$40.00, compared with $45.00-55.00 Wednesday.
COB for first quarter 1997 was quoted $21.50, while second quarter was assessed at $14.40-14.60 and third quarter was quoted $19.85.
First quarter Palo Verde was quoted $23.50-23.90, while second quarter was offered at $18.75 and third quarter was at $25.20-25.80.
Firm, peak Palo Verde (PV) electricity for Friday was quoted $40.00-45.00, compared with $45.00-50.00.
Off-peak PV for firm delivery Friday was quoted near $20.00.
Friday firm, peak prices at Four Corners were in line with PV at around $40.00. Firm, off-peak Four Corners power was assessed at $18.00-20.00.
